termsOfApplying.subtitle: Mansoura, Dakahlia Governorate
termsOfApplying.paragraph1: The school follows a modern educational approach that combines academic excellence, activities, and character building in a safe and motivating environment.
termsOfApplying.paragraph2: Admissions are open according to age requirements and available seats in each stage, with priority for students who complete the required documents and placement steps.
termsOfApplying.paragraph3: Our admissions team supports parents through each step to ensure a smooth and transparent application process from inquiry to enrollment.
